notes: Regimes are estimated on the broad market (Mkt-RF) over 9,212 observations, not on the portfolio: a regime is a property of the environment, which the portfolio then inherits. States are canonicalised by ascending volatility, so labels stay stable across refits.
Charts are restricted to the portfolio window from 2018-01-01; the parameter table above reflects the full fitted history.

Beta is cov(p,m)/var(m). In stress both the covariance and the market variance inflate and can largely cancel, so beta may stay flat or even fall while absolute risk rises sharply. Volatility is the robust effect; beta and correlation are conditional.
